summary: Design practical M&E workflows, indicator tools and reporting plans. Explore the five-day course and build a system suited to your programme.
lede: An M&E system links programme results to evidence collected during delivery, helping teams track progress and inform decisions. For programme officers, M&E practitioners and project leads, this training develops practical skills to map data flows, define indicators and responsibilities, check data quality, and turn evaluation findings into review actions using results chains and logical frameworks.
audienceIntro: This foundation course suits people who shape, operate or use programme monitoring and evaluation processes. It is designed for professionals who need to connect field data, indicator tracking and review decisions without assuming advanced statistical or software skills.
modules: Theory of Change and Logical Frameworks
Evaluation Questions and OECD DAC Criteria
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with programme objectives, activities or routine reporting is useful. Coding is not required; exercises use M&E templates and a spreadsheet-based tracker.
